catalysts.headline: IREN issued an investor-relations advisory confirming it will report Q1 FY2027 (quarter ended 2026-09-30) results on Thursday, Nov 5, 2026, with a conference call at 5:00pm ET and replay via iren.com/investors.

With IREN down roughly 40% in October and sitting near a 52-week low (~$26.62/share), three Wall Street analysts maintained price targets implying substantial upside: Sanford C. Bernstein $100, Northland Securities $99, Cantor Fitzgerald $99; average Street target cited at $77.81.
catalysts.impact: No immediate price reaction reported attributable to this specific piece; context on ongoing analyst support despite the selloff

catalysts.headline: Reported fiscal Q4 and full-year FY2026 results (year ended 2026-06-30): Q4 revenue $137.2M (miss vs ~$139-157M consensus depending on source); AI cloud revenue $70.5M, up from $33.6M QoQ (+110%), now 51.4% of quarterly revenue; bitcoin-mining revenue fell to $66.7M from $111.2M QoQ; Q4 adjusted EBITDA $19.2M (vs ~$34.9M expected); FY2026 revenue $707M (+41.1% YoY from $501M in FY2025); management said the $4B FY2026 ARR target is fully contracted, plus an incremental $700M ARR tied to an NVIDIA cloud agreement starting to ramp in 2027; FY2027 capex guided at $25B-$30B
catalysts.impact: Mixed — Q4 revenue miss and EBITDA miss against a long-term AI buildout growth narrative

catalysts.headline: Q4 FY2026: revenue $137.2M (down from $144.8M in Q3, missed ~$157.1M consensus); net loss $684.0M incl. $450.4M in asset impairments; AI Cloud revenue grew sequentially from $33.6M to $70.5M (+110% QoQ), now over half of quarterly revenue; adjusted EBITDA $19.2M (~53% below expectations). FY2026 full year: revenue $707.0M (up from $501.0M), net loss $702.6M vs FY2025 net income $86.9M. Guided FY2027 capex of $25B-$30B, with roughly $8B of funding still needed.
